sources.title: Gemma3n · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma 3n introduces MobileNet v5 as the vision encoder, using a default resolution of 768x768 pixels, and adds a newly trained audio encoder based on the Universal Speech Model (USM) architecture. The instruction-tuned variant was post-trained with knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning.
